product.name: sales_transactions
product.description: A domain-owned data product containing sales transaction records, order references, product references, customer references, quantities, prices, revenue amounts, and transaction timestamps.

business_context.business_purpose: Analyze sales transactions, revenue performance, product sales, customer purchasing activity, and transaction trends.

quality_checks: Quantity must be greater than zero
Unit price must not be negative
Total amount must not be negative
Total amount must equal quantity multiplied by unit price
Transaction timestamps must follow ISO 8601 UTC format

service_expectations.availability_expectation: Available for authorized consumers when published

limitations: The dataset is a simulated sample dataset
The dataset contains only 10 sales transactions
Customer identifiers are included but direct personal information is not included
The dataset is not intended for production financial reporting
